name: particle-image
title: Particle Image
description: An image is rebuilt out of thousands of small dots that hold the picture's own colours. Moving the pointer through it pushes the dots apart, opening a gap that slowly heals back into the shape.
use: A hero or portfolio showcase where a logo or photo should feel alive and reward the pointer moving across it.
avoid: Runs a constant canvas loop, needs a transparent source image, and the scatter is pointer-only, so touch users miss it.
a11y: The source image is hidden with empty alt and the canvas has no label, so the logo is invisible to screen readers; motion has no reduced-motion fallback. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On a black stage, the word Spark and a lightning bolt are formed from a dense field of tiny pale dots rather than solid ink. Where the cursor has passed, the dots are flung into a widening ring, leaving a hole shaped like the pointer's path. A faint caption sits above.
behaves: Every dot drifts toward its place in the picture, so the logo holds together while shimmering slightly. Sweeping the pointer across it shoves nearby dots outward on a circular wave; when the cursor leaves, they are pulled back and the logo reforms.
customise: Pass the image source, canvas size, particle gap and size, gravity, mouse force and renderer as props; colours and many motion options like fade and noise sit in the source.
weight: heavy: A requestAnimationFrame canvas loop updates thousands of dots every frame while mounted.
